entities.name: Sisters of Flesh and Spirit
entities.description: Guardians of Kamigawa after the Kami War, fusion entities born of Michiko Konda and Kyodai.

entities.name: Michiko Konda
entities.description: Mortal woman who united with Kyodai to form the Sisters; her death ended the union.

entities.name: Kyodai
entities.description: Dragon spirit, kami offspring of O-Kagachi, who now oversees the spiritual side of Kamigawa.

entities.name: O-Kagachi
entities.description: Kami whose offspring was Kyodai; destroyed by the Sisters.

entities.name: Konda
entities.description: Daimyo punished by the Sisters for the sufferings of the Kami War.

entities.name: Mochi
entities.description: Individual punished by the Sisters for the Kami War.

entities.name: Kami War
entities.description: War whose sufferings the Sisters punished and ended.

events.summary: The union of Michiko and Kyodai creates the Sisters, who destroy O-Kagachi and take his place.
events.quote: Their first act after their birth - the union of Michiko and Kyodai - was destruction of O-Kagachi and taking his place

events.summary: The Sisters punish Konda and Mochi and set out to calm the kami and end the war.
events.quote: the sisters set to calm down the kami and end the war

events.summary: The union ends when Michiko dies; Kyodai keeps a bond with each emperor.
events.quote: Although this specific unions ended when Michiko died

relations.note: Destroyed him and took his place
relations.quote: was destruction of O-Kagachi and taking his place
Kyodai , the kami offspring of O-Kagachi
